hero.subtitle: Describe your business in plain English. Braavolabs builds a fully-staffed autonomous company — content, sales, ops — that runs while you sleep. Every decision is logged, every spend is approved by you.

features.title: Everything your AI company needs
features.subtitle: From agent orchestration to memory, billing, and governance — the full stack in one platform.

agents.title: Autonomous Agents
agents.desc: Claude-powered agents with tool use, retry logic, reasoning logs, and budget controls. Every decision is recorded with a 'why' field.

memory.title: Memory Engine
memory.desc: Episodic + semantic + graph memory. Agents learn from every run. Memories go through candidate → approved → deprecated lifecycle.

pipeline.title: Pipeline Runner
pipeline.desc: Multi-step workflows with cron scheduling, BullMQ-powered queues, and step-level rollback capability.

governance.title: Governance Engine
governance.desc: Cost anomaly detection, loop prevention, spam protection, brand safety filters. Hard stops on budget overruns.

analytics.title: Analytics & CRM
analytics.desc: HubSpot integration, deal tracking, full run history, cost breakdown, and success rate metrics.

billing.title: Usage Billing
billing.desc: Stripe-powered metering. Free tier included. Scale from $0 to enterprise on demand with usage-based pricing.

audit.title: Full Audit Log
audit.desc: Every action, every tool call, every decision — permanently logged with actor, timestamp, and cost.

primitives.title: 9 Primitives
primitives.desc: Acquisition, Sales, Delivery, Content, Operations, Finance, Analytics, Memory, Governance — mix and match to build any company type.

approval.title: Spend Approval Gates
approval.desc: Only money-spending actions require human approval. Everything else runs autonomously, keeping you in control without slowing ops.
